The '''RX-77 Defense Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The model was bipedal and armed with a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]], possessing no ranged weapons.
